plainText:
Kenta Miyake (Japanese: 三宅健太 Miyake Kenta) is a Japanese voice actor for and .

==Biography==
Miyake was born on August 23, 1977, in , . He mostly played characters of the day in until the death of Hirotaka Suzuoki, the original voice actor for . As a result, starting in , Miyake took over the role of the Team Rocket leader, in addition to playing other characters. Throughout his career, Miyake was typecast as muscular and overweight people with deeper voices. He is currently affiliated with the talent agency and won the Best Supporting Actor Award during the .
